title: Annotation, Text & Dimension engine: the professional annotation subsystem
objective: Deliver the professional annotation/text/dimension subsystem on the frozen CAD/BIM Product Architecture v1.0 (Issue #82; the CAD-PARITY program's next AutoCAD-class subsystem after CAD-PARITY-004 merged at 49a7a367): the annotation/text engine (TEXT and MTEXT entities — single-line and multi-line content with insertion/attachment placement, justification, rotation, strict typed validation); the dimension system (DIMLINEAR with horizontal/vertical/rotated modes — auto-mode from the placement plus H/V flag options and the R(otation) sub-prompt — DIMALIGNED, DIMRADIUS, DIMDIAMETER, DIMANGULAR with the sector-selecting arc placement; SERVER-side measurement for every referenced target — client measurements are never trusted, they must match the recomputed value); leaders and multileaders (LEADER spines with optional annotation text, MLEADER arrow/landing/content blocks); text & dimension placement (text justification/height/rotation semantics, the DIMTEDIT text-position override, per-dimension textOverride); annotation scaling (the document-wide annotationScale standard — DIMSCALE-class — multiplying every dimension annotation's effective text height and arrow size: field × style.scale × annotationScale, persisted with the snapshot); styles → REAL rendered annotation behavior (text styles resolve font family / width factor / oblique angle LIVE at render time — changing a style visibly changes every referencing entity — and dim styles resolve text height / arrow size / overall scale / measurement precision / the NEW arrowStyle closed|tick|none and unitSuffix fields; both hosts paint through the ONE shared render-primitive + painter pipeline so the output is identical by construction); associative dimensions (dimension references re-resolve from the CURRENT geometry and re-measure inside the SAME atomic versioned batch when entity.modify or drafting.delete touches a referenced element; typed disassociation when targets vanish — the dimension survives at its last known value; annotation.remeasure for manual re-runs); the App API additions (annotation.create with server-side measurement + reference validation, annotation.update with per-type field vocabularies and null-resets, annotation.remeasure, the CommandContext style-table fields); Web/Electron parity through the same shared core + the pinned CAD-PARITY-005 fixture (36-command semantic stream, save sha a14ce71cfebd3a1d…) with the pinned CAD-PARITY-002 and CAD-PARITY-004 fixtures byte-identical (every new field additive + optional); and Vercel deployed verification of the exact PR head (the post-CAD-PARITY-002 program rule).
acceptance_criteria: Semantic correctness: every advertised annotation operation computes deterministic results with explicit typed failure behavior (LOCK-007 — empty text, zero heights, degenerate dimension extents, coincident points, parallel angular legs, unknown layers/styles/targets/anchors, field mismatches between client and recomputed measurements, locked-layer modifications and frozen-layer creations are rejected with stable codes, never silently repaired).

Measurement honesty: dimensions are measured SERVER-side from the referenced geometry (radius/diameter from the target's current circle/arc; linear extents recomputed from p1/p2 + mode; angular sweeps from the sector selection) — stored values are the document truth between updates and client-supplied measurements must match the recomputation or the create rejects.

Associativity: entity.modify AND drafting.delete cascade re-measurement for every referencing annotation inside the SAME atomic revision (one undo entry restores geometry AND dimensions together); disassociation is typed (the ref drops, the last known value survives, the echo says so) — never a silent repair and never a lost dimension.

Interaction parity: every CAD-PARITY-005 command (TEXT, MTEXT, DIMLINEAR, DIMALIGNED, DIMRADIUS, DIMDIAMETER, DIMANGULAR, LEADER, MLEADER, DIMTEDIT, DIMSCALE) is reachable from the command line (names + aliases), the ribbon/tool palette and the application menu on BOTH hosts through the ONE shared command registry and prompt engine — no host-specific command implementations.

Style-driven rendering: the SAME annotation entity renders identically on both hosts through the shared primitive/painter pipeline; text styles drive font/width/oblique live and dim styles drive text height/arrow size/precision/arrowStyle/unitSuffix live, with the document annotationScale multiplying dimension annotation geometry — style edits visibly change rendering without touching entities.

Web/Electron parity pinned: the Electron real-UI smoke (command line + canvas ENTITY/entityPoint picks through CDP) produces the IDENTICAL document (save sha256) AND the IDENTICAL 36-command semantic stream as the Web host smoke against the pinned CAD-PARITY-005 fixture; the pinned CAD-PARITY-002 and CAD-PARITY-004 fixtures stay byte-identical (additive-optional design).

Layer integration: annotations are full layer citizens — the CAD-PARITY-004 execute() locked/frozen gate applies (creation on frozen layers rejected; locked-layer modification typed-failed), display overrides resolve through the same ByLayer chain, and the properties inspector shows the per-type annotation sections with locked read-only affordances.

Deployed verification: the exact PR head is deployed to Vercel Preview and browser-verified (the post-CAD-PARITY-002 program rule) with the deployed surface serving the canonical CAD state and the annotation workflows exercising the deployed build.
non_goals: No text wrapping engine (explicit line breaks only — MTEXT lays out its lines from the stored content; the column width is a layout hint), no rich-text formatting codes, no fields/formulas, no spell checking.
No annotative per-viewport object scaling (the single document-wide annotationScale standard multiplies dimension annotation geometry; AutoCAD's CANNOSCALE-per-viewport model is out of scope).

No DIMASSOC re-association command (dimensions associate at creation through their picks/refs; re-associating an existing dimension to new geometry is not supported — remeasure maintains existing references).
No tolerance/limits/gaps dimension vocabulary (DIMTOL/DIMLIM-class formatting), no alternate-unit dimensions, no inspection dimensions.
No plot-output behavior (CAD-PARITY-008 scope) — the annotations render on the model canvas only.

DIMLINEAR/DIMALIGNED are point-defined (non-associative): the extension origins are free points; association is the entity-dimension family (radius/diameter/angular) and the annotation.create refs parameter — stated in the command descriptions and echoes.

No MTEXT in-place editor (content is collected through the command line with \n escapes); no leader spline fitting; no mleader style table (the landing/height conventions are documented deterministic defaults).
risk_assumptions: ASSUMPTION: the flat Pt-object annotation convention (drafting:true + annotation:true marks, kind:'annotation') extends the CAD-PARITY-003/004 element model without new DocumentEdit variants — annotations are elements (addElement/updateElement/setProps), styles are the existing tables, annotationScale is a DraftingSettings standard; the execute() enforcement gate applies through the existing drafting+layer markers.

ASSUMPTION: legacy COMPAT-CAD-001 dims (tuple points) load into the canonical annotation view with defaults and render through the shared painter — the legacy painter path becomes unreachable for annotation-kind elements; the pinned 002/004 fixtures contain no dims (verified) so their save shas are unaffected.

RISK: pixel-rounded canvas picks in the real-UI smoke could diverge from the typed web stream — mitigated by the side-based angular leg selection (the pick selects the half-line, not the direction) and by entity picks resolving by identity at the outline; the Electron smoke asserts the EXACT fixture sha.

RISK: the two-layer Electron paint (SVG geometry + canvas annotation overlay) cannot interleave document order — mitigated by painting annotations above geometry (the typical drafting order) with identical primitives; semantic parity (the fixture) is unaffected.

ASSUMPTION: the deterministic text metrics convention (0.6 glyph aspect × widthFactor, 1.2 line pitch) is used for pick boxes and MTEXT block layout only — device fonts render the actual glyphs; the convention is documented and identical on every host.

RISK: the prompt-engine extensions (flag options; multiple point steps staying open when non-last) touch shared machinery — pinned by the existing CAD-PARITY-002/003/004 command tests and smokes running unchanged (entity/entityPoint multiple steps keep their advance-after-first semantics; the 002/003/004 fixtures stayed byte-identical through the full gauntlet).
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated suites for the annotation vocabulary (typed constructors, exact measurement math incl. rotated projections and angular sectors, legacy dim loading), the style-driven render primitives (effective dim styles × scale × annotationScale, live text styles, arrow flip behavior, text metrics, primitive-based picking) and the App API/command surface (annotation.create server-side measurement + refs, the associative cascade through entity.modify AND drafting.delete in ONE revision, typed disassociation, annotation.update field rules, locked/frozen enforcement, save/open round-trips, the 11 command flows incl. flag options and multi-point collection), running in CI on the pinned toolchains with the full regression baseline.

Green cad-parity-005 CI workflow on the implementation head: app suite with LOCK-018 covering the extended src/workspace core (incl. annotation/ + commands-anno), Web host lint/typecheck/build + ALL THREE workspace smokes against ALL THREE pinned parity fixtures, Electron build + all twelve smokes incl. the 20-check annotation real-UI smoke asserting the SAME fixture sha AND the SAME command stream as the Web host.

Browser-verified golden paths on the dev server (the same build surface CI validates): the annotation commands through the command line, style-driven rendering, the inspector annotation sections — with zero console errors.

Deployed Vercel Preview verification of the exact PR head (post-CAD-PARITY-002 program rule): the deployed surface serves the canonical CAD state, the annotation semantic stream passes against the deployed build, and the pinned parity fixtures match — recorded as evidence before the Architect review.
